result:
I would make people unable to ignore each other.

Not make them agree, or make them nice. Just make it impossible to fully dehumanize someone you share the planet with. If you could truly, viscerally feel that the person you are dismissing, exploiting, or hurting is a real person with the same capacity for fear, hope, love and loss as you, a lot of the rest would change on its own.

Everything else — war, cruelty, greed, indifference — is downstream of that ability to look at another human and not see them.
